sources.entry: DMG Maker - DMG creation tool with polished visuals and CLI support. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/saihgupr/DMGMaker) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: A macOS app and Swift CLI for building DMG disk images with live-rendered SwiftUI mesh-gradient backgrounds and Retina-scale assets.
summary.what_it_does: DMG Maker creates macOS DMG installer images from a .app bundle. In GUI mode, you drop your .app into a drop zone, optionally drop a custom background image into a second zone, enter a volume name, and click Create DMG. If no background is supplied, it generates a mesh-gradient background automatically using SwiftUI. The README says the instruction area uses a glassmorphic "frosted glass" effect and that all assets and backgrounds are rendered at 2x scale. It also says it sets up the Applications link with naming tricks to avoid dashed boxes in Finder. A CLI mode runs headless via `swift run` with --app and --name flags, and places the resulting DMG next to the input .app bundle.
use_cases: Packaging a macOS app into a DMG for distribution
Generating DMG installers in build pipelines or scripts
Creating DMG files with a custom or auto-generated gradient background
Making a drag-to-Applications install window for a Mac app
how_to_run: Open the DMG and drag DMG Maker.app to Applications
Run Fix Security.command or: xattr -cr /Applications/DMG\ Maker.app
Open DMG Maker.app and drop your .app bundle into the first zone, then click Create DMG
notable: Auto-generated live mesh-gradient backgrounds rendered with SwiftUI
Glassmorphic instruction area using native frosted glass effects
Headless CLI mode for build pipelines
caveats: Not signed with a paid Apple Developer certificate, so on macOS Sequoia and Tahoe the app needs a security workaround (xattr command or Fix Security.command) before it opens
